card.name: Words just before harm or suffering
card.fires_on: Linking words such as 'to' or 'of', and some digits, right before a word for harm, death or suffering is expected. Seen in opioid warnings and in text on factory farming or violence.

modes.label: Lead-in to death or harm
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'of' just before a harm term like respiratory arrest or violence.
modes.example: may lead<< to>> respiratory arrest and death.

modes.description: Words about animals raised in factory farms, before terms like inhumane conditions.
